title: CertMoE: Robustness Certification for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Routing-Aware Smoothing
abstract: arXiv:2610.29395v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Provable robustness is a cornerstone of trustworthy machine learning, aiming to guarantee model predictions under adversarial perturbations. Existing certification frameworks, inspired by abstract interpretation or symbolic execution, typically assume a fixed computation graph, where input perturbations or variations affect only model outputs but not the underlying execution path. This assumption, however, is violated in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs), whose input-dependent routing induces discrete and dynamic execution paths. Crucially, this dynamic computation changes the certified object from a single fixed function to a composition of input-dependent sub-functions, leading to unreliable certification guarantees.   This paper presents \textsc{CertMoE}, the first routing-aware robustness certification framework for MoE LLMs, which explicitly accounts for input-induced routing dynamics in certification. Specific

translated_title: CertMoE：通过路由感知平滑实现的混合专家大语言模型鲁棒性认证
translated_abstract: 可证明鲁棒性是可信机器学习的基石，旨在保证模型在对抗扰动下的预测。现有的认证框架受抽象解释或符号执行启发，通常假设固定的计算图，即输入扰动或变化只影响模型输出，而不影响底层执行路径。然而，这一假设在混合专家大语言模型中并不成立，因为其依赖输入的路由机制会产生离散且动态的执行路径。至关重要的是，这种动态计算将认证对象从单一固定函数变成了依赖输入的子函数的组合，导致认证保证不可靠。本文提出了CertMoE，这是首个针对混合专家大语言模型的路由感知鲁棒性认证框架，它在认证过程中显式地考虑了由输入引发的路由动态。
tldr: 该论文提出了CertMoE，首个针对混合专家大语言模型的路由感知鲁棒性认证框架，通过显式建模输入依赖的动态路由，解决了现有认证方法因假设固定计算图而失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CertMoE, the first routing-aware robustness certification framework for MoE LLMs, which explicitly accounts for input-induced routing dynamics, overcoming the failure of existing certification methods that assume a fixed computation graph.
